title: nan
authors: Carrasco P.; Cuesta F.; Caballero R.; Perez-Grau F.J.; Viguria A.
key_contribution: Presents onboard probabilistic 3D localization for aerial robots in industrial GNSS-denied environments using a 3D laser scanner, radio sensors, prior map, and odometry.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
